
```{r}
Elite<-rep("No",nrow(College))
Elite(College$Top10perc > 50)="Yes"
Elite=data.frame(Elite)
College=data_frame(College,Elite)

```


```{r}
plot(College$Elite,College$Outstate,xlab=("Eliteuniversity"),ylab=("Tuitionin$"),
     col=c("red","green"))
```
